language.note: rexxae_register_function: a script calls named host functions with typed JSON arguments; the host answers each request.

language.feature: No file, network or OS effects without a host grant
language.note: The library build has no fs/net/os capability; tools/check_containment.py and make containment hold it.

language.feature: Host requests: COMMAND, FUNCTION, LOG events and suspension
language.note: aether_rexxae_step returns a request and the engine suspends until the host replies; no callbacks into the host.

language.feature: EXPORT('label') and rexxae_call: the host calls a script's labels
language.note: The worker serves exported labels over std.guest INVOKE; rexxae_call runs a label of a finished program.
The one thread-safe entry point; the script cannot catch it.
aether_rexxae_step(ctx, budget) returns RUNNABLE when the budget is spent.

language.note: Loads JavaScript modules into the interpreter; RexxAE's REQUIRE goes to a host resolver and loads Rexx only.
